samples.summary: rest-api.md — the canonical /api/v1 design doc — is not updated for the ~12 new endpoints this change adds
samples.evidence: §5 enumerates every v1 route family and §6 lists the controller files. The diff adds ApiV1CommentsController (6 routes), ApiV1SlidesController (4 routes + `GET layouts`), ApiV1WorksheetImagesController (GET/PUT images), `DELETE tabs/:tid`, `POST tabs/:tid/reorder`, `POST tabs/:tid/duplicate`, and board dispatch on `PUT .../content` — none appear in rest-api.md. §5.2 still states the tab surface as `GET`/`POST`/`PATCH` only, and §5.5 still says the content endpoint serves `doc`/`slides`/`note`. The precedent set by the class-A and A′ work (§5.6–§5.8 folders/files/images were added to this doc) is that a new v1 surface is recorded here. The `reorder`-vs-`move` naming decision (documented only in a code comment in tabs.controller.ts) is exactly the kind of contract fact this doc exists to carry.

samples.summary: cli.md's Command Tree is not updated for the new `board`, `comments`, `sheets images`, `slides layouts`/`slide` and `tabs delete|move|duplicate` commands
samples.evidence: §4 Command Tree (cli.md:386-557) is the canonical listing of the CLI surface and was extended for the earlier class-A/A′ work (`folders`, `images`, `set-content`, `docs copy|move` all appear). This diff registers five new command groups/verbs in packages/cli/src/cli.ts and packages/cli/src/commands/* plus 20 new schema registry entries, and cli.md still shows `tabs` with only `list|create|rename` and no `board`/`comments` namespaces at all.

samples.summary: comments-mentions.md still declares the mention grammar as a frontend module after this change moved it into @wafflebase/sheets
samples.evidence: comments-mentions.md:87 titles the section "New shared helper — `packages/frontend/src/components/comments/mentions.ts`" and :127 describes `extractMentionedUserIds` as consumed only by a unit test. The diff moves the grammar and all four helpers to `packages/sheets/src/comment/mentions.ts`, leaves the frontend file as a re-export shim, and makes the backend a second consumer. notifications.md records the move; the doc that actually owns the mention design does not, so the canonical doc for this subsystem is now wrong about where its module lives.

samples.summary: A third/fourth declaration of the board content shape instead of reusing `@wafflebase/board`'s `BoardModel`, leaving `template/seed/board.ts` stale
samples.evidence: `@wafflebase/board` already exports `BoardModel = { meta: { title, unit?, recentColors? }, elements: Element[] }` (packages/board/src/model/board.ts:22) — byte-for-byte the new `BoardDocument`. The backend now also has `BoardYorkieRoot`, alongside the pre-existing `BoardRoot` in packages/backend/src/template/seed/board.ts:13, whose docblock now asserts something false: "There is no backend writer for boards the way there is for docs / slides / notes — `PUT /documents/:id/content` covers only those three". Reusing `BoardModel` (backend would need the workspace dep, as it already has @wafflebase/slides) or at minimum folding the seed's `BoardRoot` into the new module would keep one statement of the shape; four copies are what drift.

samples.summary: The Yorkie comment-store shell is now written a third time (backend) beside the docs and PDF frontend stores, and the copies have already diverged
samples.evidence: comment-ops.ts reimplements `toYorkieMs`/`fromYorkieMs`, `copyThread`/`copyAuthor`, splice-not-reassign delete and the resolve/reopen field writes that packages/frontend/src/app/docs/comments/yorkie-comment-store.ts (lines 48-51, 104, 255, 264-275) and app/files/comments/pdf-comment-store.ts already implement. Divergence is not hypothetical: the new `applySetResolved` guards `delete thread.resolvedAt` on key presence, while yorkie-comment-store.ts:272 deletes unguarded — the same operation now behaves differently depending on which writer performs it. The thread *rules* are correctly shared through `@wafflebase/sheets`; only the CRDT plumbing is triplicated, and nothing in this change records where that plumbing is supposed to live.

samples.summary: `PATCH .../comments/:threadId/comments/:commentId` (edit a comment) has no CLI command and no schema entry — the endpoint-without-a-command shape this work exists to close
samples.evidence: comments.controller.ts adds `editComment` with full author-only authorization and tests, but packages/cli/src/client/http-client.ts exposes no `editComment`, packages/cli/src/commands/comments.ts registers list/add/reply/resolve/unresolve/delete/delete-comment only, and packages/cli/src/schema/registry.ts has no `comments.edit`. Per the capability audit's own framing (class A = "endpoint exists under /api/v1, no CLI command"), this closes class B while opening a new class-A item.

samples.summary: The capability audit's class-B table gets no status note, unlike classes A and A′ which each received one when closed
samples.evidence: §3 class A (line ~140) and class A′ (line ~166) both carry an explicit "Status note (Step N of the todo, landed after this audit)" paragraph recording that the row is now covered while leaving the table as measured. This change closes all five class-B rows (comments, slide granular editing, tab rearrange, sheet floating images, board) and adds no equivalent note, so the document that drives the roadmap and the bench comparison still reads as though 18 items are unreachable.

samples.summary: Only sheets/comments.md records the new second writer; the docs and PDF comment design docs are untouched though the same API writes their threads
samples.evidence: The diff amends docs/design/sheets/comments.md to note that `/api/v1/.../comments` is now a writer and enforces author-only edit/delete. The controller equally lists/replies/resolves/deletes threads stored by docs (`docs-comments.md`) and PDF (`pdf.md`) documents, and refuses thread *creation* on a `doc` — a limitation a reader of those docs has no way to learn. Filing the note only under the sheets doc leaves the other two subsystem docs describing an editor-only lifecycle.
searchedFor: grep 'api/v1' in docs/design (pdf.md not in diff)

samples.summary: Two behavior changes unrelated to the class-B closure ride along in this diff
samples.evidence: The workspace-slug uniqueness fix in test/helpers/integration-helpers.ts and the `unwrapJson` switch from bare `JSON.parse` to `parseJsonSnapshot` (which changes behavior for pre-existing chart and slides readers) are both defensible on their own, but neither is part of "add the missing comment / slide / tab / image / board surface". They would be easier to reason about — and to revert — as their own change.
